bio.text: Rob Sampson represents the 16th Senate District, which includes Cheshire, Prospect, Southington, Waterbury and Wolcott, and was re-elected in November 2024 to a fourth term.
He previously served four terms in the Connecticut House of Representatives, representing the 80th District from 2011 to 2018.
Born in New Haven in 1969 and raised in Meriden, he graduated from Maloney High School and attended Central Connecticut State University, majoring in marketing.
He later worked in real estate and insurance.
